title: Covel runtime manifest
description: Frontmatter of `runtimes/<id>/RUNTIME.md`, and the inline `runtime` of a root `PLUGIN.md`.

type.description: `agent` drives model tool calls from the prompt body. `function` runs a JavaScript handler.

description.description: What the runtime does. Plain string; translations go in locale files.

stage.description: Stage the runtime runs in. Required for `auto` and `scheduled` triggers. Order: `setup`, `pre-turn`, `narrative`, `post-turn`, `audit`.

type.description: `auto` runs every turn in its stage. `scheduled` runs every `interval` turns. `manual` runs on an explicit RPC call. `event` runs when `topic` is emitted.

topic.description: Event topic to subscribe to. Required for `event`.

maxTriggerCount.description: Maximum number of triggers in one session.

cooldownTurns.description: Minimum number of turns between two triggers.

startTurn.description: First logical turn at which the runtime may trigger. When unset, it triggers as soon as its stage opens.

runtime.description: Runtime ID in this package: `<pluginId>/<runtimeId>`, or the package ID for a single runtime.

scope.description: `turn` gates on the same execution. `session` gates on the persistent setup snapshot and is valid only on stage `setup`.

contract.description: Contract ID. It must be listed in the package's `requires` or `optional`.

cardinality.description: `one` takes a single provider; `all` takes every provider.

scope.description: `turn` gates on the same execution. `session` gates on the persistent setup snapshot and is valid only on stage `setup`.

needs.description: Upstream runtimes or contracts that must succeed first. Sets order and gates this runtime.

runtime.description: Runtime ID in this package: `<pluginId>/<runtimeId>`, or the package ID for a single runtime.

contract.description: Contract ID. It must be listed in the package's `requires` or `optional`.

cardinality.description: `one` takes a single provider; `all` takes every provider.

after.description: Upstream runtimes or contracts that run first. Sets order only; it does not gate and does not activate a provider.

mode.description: `await` makes the turn wait for this runtime. `detached` lets the turn finish first; it is valid only on `post-turn` and `audit` stages. Defaults to `await`.

settle.description: Makes the next player action wait until this detached runtime settles.

maxSettleWaitMs.description: Longest time in ms the next action waits for settlement. Requires `settle`.

maxQueueMs.description: Longest time in ms a detached job may wait in the queue.

maxExecutionMs.description: Longest time in ms a detached job may run.

overlap.description: Overlap policy for detached jobs of this runtime. Only `serial` is supported.

stalePolicy.description: Policy for a detached job that has become stale. Only `reject` is supported.

completion.description: Whether the turn waits for this runtime.

execution.description: `sync` awaits the result. `background` queues a durable job and returns its ID.

schedule.description: When and in what order the runtime runs.

runtime.description: Runtime ID in this package: `<pluginId>/<runtimeId>`, or the package ID for a single runtime.

contract.description: Contract ID. It must be listed in the package's `requires` or `optional`.

cardinality.description: `one` takes a single provider; `all` takes every provider.

kernel.description: Kernel input: the frozen last player input and the runtime results observed so far.

from.description: Producer of the value: a runtime in this package, a contract, or a kernel input.

scope.description: `turn` reads the same execution's upstream result. `committed` reads the latest committed export and needs `recordAs`. Defaults to `turn`.

select.description: JSON Pointer applied to the upstream value. Declaring `select` with `scope: committed` is rejected; committed inputs read the complete export.

required.description: `true` stops this runtime when the upstream value is missing or failed.

accepts.description: Schema the bound value must satisfy: a local path or `contract:<contractId>`. It adds to the public contract check.

recordAs.description: Export key to read from the producer. Required with `scope: committed`.

inputs.description: Typed input bindings keyed by local name. An agent reads them at `runtime-inputs.<name>.value`.

namespace.description: Own data namespace to inline. Data of other plugins cannot be read.

as.description: Tag that wraps the injected block in the prompt.

format.description: `summary` lists key, update time and truncated JSON. `ids-only` lists keys. `full` lists complete JSON. Defaults to `summary`.

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of entries injected. Above it, half are the oldest and half the most recently updated. Defaults to 50.

selfData.description: Own plugin data inlined into the agent prompt.

payloadSchema.description: Schema that validates the activation payload.

contract.description: Contract this runtime's output publishes. It must be listed in the package's `provides`.

schema.description: Private schema that validates the runtime's output.

recordAs.description: Export key under which the output is persisted for later executions. Requires `schema`.

visibility.description: Output kind the kernel dispatches on: `story` for the main narrative provider, `plugin` for plugin output, `system` for system output.

concealed.description: `true` for a runtime that handles hidden content. Its prompt, model reply, tool arguments, results and output are removed from traces, live streams and API results, and text it returns is not written to the conversation. Not allowed with `visibility: story`.

io.description: What the runtime reads and produces.

reasoningEffort.description: `disabled` turns model reasoning off for this runtime.

name.description: Name of the tool to force.

toolChoice.description: `required` forces a tool call on every step. `{ name }` forces one named tool.

llm.description: Model call options for this runtime.

includeSummaries.description: Include persisted summaries alongside the bounded history window. Defaults to false.

maxTurns.description: Number of most recent turns kept in the agent's prompt history. `0` sends no history.

history.description: Bounds the agent's prompt history. When omitted, the runtime sees the shared session history.

builtin.description: Names of builtin tools the runtime may call.

plugin.description: Names of this package's own tools the runtime may call. Each must be listed in `contributes.tools`. The runtime of a single-runtime package gets every contributed tool when this is omitted.

defer.description: Deferred tool loading. `true` defers the whole whitelist; a list defers only those names.

tools.description: Tools the agent's model may call.

advertiseEvents.description: `true` lists the session's event directory in the prompt so the model knows which topics it may emit.

maxSteps.description: Maximum number of tool-call steps. Use 1 or 2 for a runtime that calls one tool and stops.

timeoutMs.description: Time limit of the runtime in ms. The time a streamed model call spends writing does not count.

callTimeoutMs.description: Time limit of one model call that is not streamed, in ms.

firstTokenTimeoutMs.description: Time limit for the first streamed token in ms. Defaults to 120000.

idleTimeoutMs.description: Longest silence of a streamed model call that has started to write, in ms. A model that keeps writing is not cut off. Defaults to 120000.

maxRetries.description: Retries on a transient model failure. Defaults to 1; `0` disables retry.

loopDetection.description: Number of repeated tool calls that counts as a loop. Defaults to 3; `0` disables detection.

maxRecursionDepth.description: Maximum depth of nested `ctx.recursiveCall()`. Defaults to 10.

require.description: `explicit` needs a completing tool or `runtime-done`. `tool-use` needs a valid business tool call, so "no change" is also submitted through the tool.

afterTools.description: The runtime completes after a successful call to one of these tools.

loop.description: Limits and completion rules of the agent loop.

agent.description: Settings of an `agent` runtime. Not allowed on a `function` runtime.

handler.description: Path of the handler module. The module default-exports the handler function.

model.description: Model slot the handler's gateway calls route through. Declared so a detached job's credential readiness check judges the same slot the call resolves.

timeoutMs.description: Time limit of the handler in ms.

builtin.description: Names of builtin tools the runtime may call.

plugin.description: Names of this package's own tools the runtime may call. Each must be listed in `contributes.tools`. The runtime of a single-runtime package gets every contributed tool when this is omitted.

defer.description: Deferred tool loading. `true` defers the whole whitelist; a list defers only those names.

tools.description: Tools the handler may call through `ctx.tools.call`.

function.description: Settings of a `function` runtime. Required when `type` is `function`.

guard.description: Path of the guard module. It runs before the runtime and can skip it.

reads.description: Resources the runtime reads, such as `narrative:*` or `plugin-data:self:<namespace>`. Entries must be unique.

writes.description: Resources the runtime writes, such as `state:*` or `event:<topic>`. Entries must be unique.

parallelSafe.description: `true` states that the runtime is safe to run in parallel with its stage siblings.

effects.description: Declared read and write sets, used to detect parallel hazards.

origin.description: HTTPS origin the runtime may call, without path, query or credentials.

methods.description: HTTP methods allowed for the origin. Entries must be unique.

http.description: Upper bound of the HTTP origins and methods the runtime may use.
